tools.name: search_address
tools.description: Look up a residential building (apartment block, house, residential complex) by its address and get the reviews of people who lived there: ratings 1-5 and their words about noise, damp, heating, water, the landlord or the management. Use before renting or buying a home at an address, in any country.

tools.description: The newest reviews of residential buildings on AskResidents, optionally of one country.
